name: GAOKAO-Bench
description: An intuitive benchmark using questions from the Chinese GAOKAO examination, including subjective and objective questions, to comprehensively evaluate large language models' performance in a zero-shot setting aligned with human examination methods.
reputation: A well-known Chinese exam-based benchmark that has been widely used to test LLM reasoning and exam-style performance in a realistic zero-shot setting.
notes: Includes both subjective and objective questions from GAOKAO; also uses LLMs to grade subjective answers with moderate consistency to human scores.
